label: Fintech Regulatory Sandbox Application
description: Prepare regulatory sandbox applications. Covers eligibility criteria, test parameters, consumer protection safeguards, and graduation pathway to full licensing.

claudeKnowledge.description: Regulatory sandbox frameworks by jurisdiction, CBK Kenya fintech sandbox, Bank of Ghana fintech regulatory sandbox, MAS Singapore fintech regulatory sandbox, FCA sandbox programme, ADGM RegLab, FSRA sandbox

guidedInputs.label: Target Sandbox Jurisdiction
guidedInputs.description: Which regulator's sandbox is the applicant targeting?

guidedInputs.label: Innovation Description
guidedInputs.description: Briefly describe the fintech innovation or product being tested.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. AI-powered credit scoring for unbanked users using mobile data and psychometric testing, with automated loan disbursement via mobile wallet...

guidedInputs.label: Regulatory Barrier
guidedInputs.description: What regulatory requirements make it difficult to launch this product under the current framework?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Current regulations require a full banking licence to offer deposit-like products, but our product is a limited-purpose savings wrapper — a full banking licence is disproportionate for the product scope and scale we are proposing to test...
